attributes.action: Graduate jobs for newly qualified paramedics
attributes.additional_details: I urge the UK Government to address the serious shortage of employment opportunities for newly qualified paramedics. After years of demanding academic study, practical training and significant financial investment, graduates are finding themselves unable to secure entry level positions. Parliament must work with ambulance services to create more entry-level positions, ensuring newly qualified paramedics can serve their communities and help meet the growing demand for emergency care.
attributes.background: Address and support Paramedic graduates who cannot get a job in the NHS due to lack of funding for the role across the UK, with 40% of graduates unable to find employment.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Fund more entry level roles for NHS graduate paramedics
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781925

Extend the NHS Graduate Guarantee to newly qualified paramedics
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782415
